topic: What Is an ABN and Why It Matters for Finance
objective: Explain the ABN's role in a business finance application.

slides.headline: What does it mean?
slides.body: Your Australian Business Number (ABN) identifies your business to the ATO and other agencies, and it's one of the first things a lender checks. How long your ABN has been active often factors into eligibility, particularly for lower-doc or faster-turnaround facilities.

caption:
Your ABN is more than a registration number, it's one of the first things a lender looks at to confirm your business is real, active, and trading. How long it's been registered often factors into which lenders and products you're eligible for.

If you've recently registered, that doesn't rule out finance, it just means certain lenders who specialise in newer businesses may be a better fit than others.
